nom: COSRX Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report less oil production and a more balanced complexion with regular use, though one notes the essence tends to build up specifically on her very oily forehead, so she skips that area.
segments.dry: The large majority of reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe it locking in moisture, softening skin overnight and closing dry patches, often after other hyaluronic acids failed them; one reviewer with dry, acne-prone skin disagrees, finding it too thin and not hydrating enough, and says it left her skin looking dull.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are divided: several, including some who also describe sensitive or dry-combination skin, report smaller pores and no dry patches, while one 22-year-old with combination skin found it turned uncomfortably sticky, like maple syrup, as it dried.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing eczema or rosacea, report no irritation, no fragrance reaction and noticeably calmer, more hydrated skin; one 31-year-old with sensitive, acne-prone skin is the exception, developing a batch of small white pimples days after starting it.
segments.normal: The one adult reviewer who tags her skin normal/combination reports zero irritation and needing only a small amount; another reviewer notes the essence worked well when she let her 9-year-old daughter, who has normal skin, try it too.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who identify as mature, one 49 and one 47, both call it a favorite, one comparing it favorably to higher-end essences and the other, who also has dry skin, describing it as a serum her skin loves.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and creases around the eyes, mouth, and forehead report them visibly plumped or smoothed, in some cases overnight and after just a week or two of use; no reviewer reports it failing to soften lines.
concerns.dehydration: This is the essence's most consistently reported effect: reviewers across dry, oily, and sensitive skin describe overnight plumping, smoother skin and dry patches disappearing. Two reviewers dissent — one found it thinner and less hydrating than a comparable product from The Ordinary and left her skin looking dull, another says it hasn't fully resolved her dehydration even after regular use, though she feels her skin is improving.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive redness report calmer, more even-toned skin and no flare-ups; one reviewer had the opposite reaction, with her face turning flushed, hot and visibly irritated within minutes of application.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing a weakened or eczema-prone barrier describe the essence as repairing and locking in moisture without irritation; one reviewer specifically credits it with helping rebuild her moisture barrier and reducing oil production as a result. No reviewer reports it weakening or irritating the barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her dark spots appeared lighter after a week of regular use, alongside clearer, brighter, smoother skin overall.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone or fungal-acne-safe, report no new breakouts and some clearing of existing acne; three disagree, describing an instant breakout they attribute to the fragrance ingredients, a batch of small white pimples days into use, or breakouts when applying it too often.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report less oil production and a mattified, hydrated-not-slick finish after switching to this essence from other serums; one reviewer with an oily forehead finds the product builds up specifically in that area and avoids applying it there.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky if you overapply
Can be hard to find in stock
Layers well under makeup and skincare

extraits.texte: when you do the math, this and the ordinary are the same price. but this one is thinner and therefore not as hydrating on my dry, acne prone skin. it feels like water and after I apply it, it doesnt feel like I added a serum or much hydration at all. honestly, it actually left my skin looking dull. I know this isnt supposed to be like a moisturizer but in the end The Ordinary's was superior because it was more slimy (but dries like nothing is on your face) and seemed to lock in more moisture and the vitamin seems to give my face life. so try this if you dont like the feeling of stuff of your face, but there really isnt much moisture.

When I first applied this product it felt gooey then when my skin absorbed it it left my skin 10% sticky which was annoying but manageable. My skin felt tingley, but I still wanted to give it a try. For the next few days I notice that my skin looked more hydrated and more plump. Which I loved, but now I've developed a bunch of small white pimples on my face. This is the only new product that I've tested in almost a week. I want to love this product be its definitely not for sensitive skin. I did let my 9 year old try it and it did wonders to her skin. My daughter has normal skin. I'm 31 with sensitive acne prone skin for reference.
this product didn't work for me :/ it became sticky when it dried down like maple syrup or honey type sticky. very uncomfortable & disappointed with this product 😓

One of my most fav HA. I have tried LRP one. But this one is amazing. Helps clear my skin. Deeply hyrdrates. Repaired my damaged barrier. Has no actives..:. Recommend for all sensitive reactive barrier skin..

I have pretty oily skin and I read that this is often because your skin is dehydrated. I picked this up on a recommendation and not really sure what to expect. I first used only this product at night in order to "reset" my skin and build back my moisture barrier. I definitely noticed less oil production throughout the day when normally my forehead would be slick. Now, I mostly use it if I've exfoliated too much, on days I drink (bring back that moisture) or just more calm days. I wake up seeing a difference in my skin hydration, smoothness. This is my second time repurchasing - the product lasts a long time and a little goes a long way.

Highly recommend for mature skin. I am 49 and this essence rocks and is comparable to higher end and more prestige essence products. Make sure you press into skin and use your serum(s) while skin is still damp from essence.

extraits.titre: Difference after a week of use
extraits.texte: I've only been using this product for about 2 weeks. I have been using it at night after double cleansing and before a moisturizer. It's been the only serum/extra product I've been using to really see how it works. I bought this product because I felt my skin was getting too dehydrated and I wanted to add some extra moisture. After a week of use I feel like my skin is clearer, brighter and smoother. My dark spots also seem to have lightened after regular use. My issues with dehydration aren't gone but I definitely feel like my skin is on the right path again.
